info.quarryindustrial.quarry: Place it facing you: it mines a square area behind it. First it builds a steel gantry frame, then it digs layer by layer to the bottom of the world. Needs EU (any Team Reborn Energy cable) and a drill bit. Pipe water in for +25%% speed and half the bit wear. Drops go to an adjacent chest or pipe.
info.quarryindustrial.quarry_core: Nuclear Quarry: put the core in the middle of the front face of a 3x3x3 cube of Quarry Casing, with 1 to 8 HV Energy Ports instead of some casings (one reactor per port). Missing blocks show up as a hologram. It overheats without water.
info.quarryindustrial.energy_port: HV input for the Nuclear Quarry. Each port takes up to 512 EU/t: one Ala Industrial reactor per port.
info.quarryindustrial.pumpjack: Place it over the 1x1 shaft of an Ala Industrial oil geyser, facing the shaft. It drains the dome, then pumps oil forever. Runs on EU or on diesel fed into the motor row (the back of the base).
info.quarryindustrial.offshore_rig: Place it on the ocean surface (at least 8 blocks deep): it builds a 7x7 deck and legs down to the seabed. It drills the seabed (EU + a drill bit) and then produces oil forever. Oil comes out of any deck block.
info.quarryindustrial.diesel_generator: Burns Ala Industrial diesel, fuel oil or biofuel and outputs up to 128 EU/t to adjacent cables and machines.
info.quarryindustrial.steam_turbine: Place it right in front of an Ala Industrial Steam Nozzle outlet: it caps the vent and turns the reactor steam into EU (2 EU per mB). Also accepts steam from any pipe.
info.quarryindustrial.drone_pad: Home of a drone. It has an outbox (pipes put things in, and it pulls from chests and tanks next to it) and an inbox (what other drones bring, pushed to its neighbours). Each trip costs energy from the pad.
info.quarryindustrial.drone_linker: Sneak + right-click the source pad, then right-click the destination pad.
info.quarryindustrial.pad_chunk_loader: Right-click a drone pad to install it. The pad keeps its chunk (and the machines next to it) loaded even when you are far away. Dropped when the pad breaks.
info.quarryindustrial.survey_range_upgra: Right-click a pad to boost its survey drone's radius (stacks, up to 4). Longer flights take longer and cost more energy. Dropped when the pad breaks.
info.quarryindustrial.drone_radar: Repeater for the Drone Console. Place it inside the area the console (or another radar) already sees and it adds its own radius around itself. Chain them to cover any distance.
info.quarryindustrial.manual: Everything about the mod, in game. You also get one with your first quarry.
info.quarryindustrial.drill_bit: Quarries and offshore rigs need a drill bit. It wears with every block (more with hard ones, half with water) and breaks at the end of its life. Each bit is crafted from the previous one.
info.quarryindustrial.cargo_drone: Put it on a pad and link the pad: it carries items between them.
info.quarryindustrial.tanker_drone: Carries fluids between two linked pads: perfect for offshore oil.
info.quarryindustrial.power_drone: Carries EU between two linked pads: power for quarries far from the grid.
info.quarryindustrial.maintenance_drone: Put spare drill bits in its pad: it swaps worn bits on quarries and rigs within 48 blocks.
info.quarryindustrial.survey_drone: Right-click its pad to launch a survey: it sweeps a 128-block radius and brings back a report with every oil geyser it saw.
